title: Long-Term Agent Memory through Complementary Curation and Consolidation
title_zh: 通过互补的策展与整合实现智能体长期记忆

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon dialogue agents require effective memory systems to recall facts, events, and relationships from interaction histories. In this work, we propose a hybrid-memory architecture comprising episodic memories and structured relational memories and a consolidation mechanism which improves efficiency. We conduct an empirical study across two benchmarks: LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S. Our experiments demonstrate that the two memory types are consistently complementary, combining both outperforms state-of-the-art memory frameworks and achieves 90.2% accuracy on LoCoMo and 85.5% on LongMemEval-S.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程对话智能体需要有效的记忆系统，以从交互历史中回忆事实、事件和关系。 在本工作中，我们提出了一种由情景记忆和结构化关系记忆组成的混合记忆架构，以及一种可提升效率的整合机制。 我们在两个基准（LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S）上开展了实证研究。 我们的实验表明，这两类记忆始终具有互补性，将二者结合优于最先进的记忆框架，并在 LoCoMo 上达到 90.2% 的准确率，在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 85.5%。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic capability of sustaining multi-turn interactions Wang et al. (2024) ; Hu et al. (2025) . However, their ability to recall, integrate, and reason over long interaction histories remains fundamentally limited. These limitations have motivated the development of long-term memory systems that explicitly store and retrieve learning from past interactions Zhang et al. (2025) . By enabling selective access to historical experience, these mechanisms mitigate the need for massive context windows, fostering more coherent and efficient agent behavior.

paragraphs.en: Prior work on agentic memories can be primarily categorized into two types. Parametric memory Wei et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) embeds knowledge directly into model parameters through training, enabling low-latency inference; however, encoding is computationally expensive, frequent updates are infeasible, and unconstrained modifications may induce hallucination. In contrast, non-parametric memory Chhikara et al. (2025) ; Rasmussen et al. (2025) ; Nan et al. (2025) leverages external memory systems that store and retrieve information on demand, offering scalability and adaptability without training, though at the expense of additional retrieval latency.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we focus on the latter approach, and propose a hybrid memory system of episodic memory which stores distinct events from the interactions, preserving the temporal ordering and contextual richness, and structured relational memory which extracts entity specific tuples from dialogues, making implicit connections between people, places, and facts explicit and enabling relational inference across sessions. These two representations reflect fundamentally different assumptions about what makes memory useful: episodic memory preserves narrative context and sequence , while structured relational memory prioritizes compact, queryable relational structure . Furthermore, we introduce an offline memory consolidation mechanism that selectively merges related or redundant memories and removes conflicting or outdated entries, enabling scalable and efficient long-term memory management.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们聚焦于后一种方法，提出了一种混合记忆系统，其中情景记忆存储交互中发生的不同事件，保留时间顺序与上下文丰富性，而结构化关系记忆从对话中提取实体相关的三元组，将人物、地点与事实之间的隐含联系显式化，并支持跨会话的关系推理。 这两种表示体现了关于什么使记忆有用的根本不同假设：情景记忆保留叙事上下文与顺序，而结构化关系记忆则优先考虑紧凑、可查询的关系结构。 此外，我们引入了一种离线记忆整合机制，选择性地合并相关或冗余的记忆，并删除冲突或过时的条目，从而实现可扩展且高效的长期记忆管理。

paragraphs.en: Our empirical results demonstrate that episodic and structured relational memory together deliver strong empirical performance, with our hybrid system outperforming state-of-the-art baseline methods on both benchmarks. Our memory consolidation method further shows effective compression of the memory store by 16.34% without much loss in performance. Moreover, on the LoCoMo benchmark, the consolidated system improves accuracy on both single-hop and multi-hop QA tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实证结果表明，情景记忆与结构化关系记忆相结合能够带来出色的实证表现，我们的混合系统在两个基准测试上的表现均优于最先进的基线方法。 我们的记忆巩固方法还进一步表明，能够在性能损失很小的情况下将记忆存储有效压缩16.34%。 此外，在LoCoMo基准测试上，巩固后的系统在单跳和多跳问答任务上的准确率均有所提升。

paragraphs.en: Our work differs in two ways. First, we combine episodic memory with a lightweight relational tuple store retrieved by semantic similarity and grounded with timestamps and source context, leveraging complementary narrative and entity-relation memories. Second, our offline consolidation phase merges redundant memories, improving efficiency without much loss in accuracy. A detailed comparison is provided in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作在两个方面有所不同。 首先，我们将情景记忆与一种轻量级关系元组存储相结合，该存储通过语义相似度进行检索，并以时间戳和来源上下文作为依据，从而利用叙事记忆与实体关系记忆的互补优势。 其次，我们的离线整合阶段会合并冗余记忆，在几乎不损失准确率的情况下提升效率。 详细对比见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid memory operates in three phases: an offline curation phase that processes each conversation session, an offline consolidation phase, and a final retrieval-and-generation phase that responds to user queries. Figure 1 presents an overview of our proposed memory system.

paragraphs.en: Both memory stores are populated at session granularity: after each conversation session concludes, we run curation over its transcript.
paragraphs.zh: 两个记忆存储库均以会话（session）为粒度进行填充：每次对话会话结束后，我们对其转录内容进行整理（curation）。

paragraphs.en: For each session, we create holistic episodic memories using an LLM. As shown in Figure 1 , each entry contains three fields: a short title identifying the episode, a one-sentence summary distilling its key point, and a details paragraph preserving the narrative context, including the event and any relevant background. Each episodic record is additionally annotated with the session timestamp. The prompt for episodic memory curation is shown in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: We observe that conversations naturally express persistent facts about entities and their relationships, including who someone is, what they do, who they are connected to. These relationships are better represented as structured relational tuples. To this end, we prompt an LLM to extract entity-relation tuples from the dialogues. Each tuple is stored as ( e , r , o , t , c ) (e,\,r,\,o,\,t,\,c) . As shown in Figure 1 , e e is the entity , r r the relation label , o o the object , t t the timestamp , and c c the source context which captures the richer context from which the tuple was extracted. The contextual description c c provides provenance: it records not just what the tuple asserts but in what context it was mentioned, which is important for preserving nuance that structured extraction inevitably loses, such as the speaker’s intent, the circumstances under which a fact was stated, and additional details. The timestamp t t additionally grounds each triplet temporally, addressing a common failure mode of relation-based memory where relational facts are stored without any record of when they were true. The prompt for relational memory curation is shown in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，对话会自然地表达关于实体及其关系的持久事实，包括某个人是谁、做什么、与谁相连。 这些关系更适合用结构化的关系元组来表示。 为此，我们提示大语言模型从对话中抽取实体-关系元组。 每个元组存储为 ( e , r , o , t , c ) (e,\,r,\,o,\,t,\,c) 。 如图 1 所示， e e 是实体， r r 是关系标签， o o 是对象， t t 是时间戳， c c 是来源上下文，它捕获了元组被抽取时所处的更丰富的上下文。 上下文描述 c c 提供了来源追溯：它不仅记录元组断言了什么，还记录了它在什么上下文中被提及，这对于保留结构化抽取不可避免丢失的细微信息非常重要，例如说话者的意图、陈述某一事实时的情形，以及其他细节。 时间戳 t t 还为每个三元组提供了时间上的锚定，解决了基于关系的记忆的一个常见失败模式，即关系事实在被存储时没有记录它们何时为真。 用于关系记忆整理的提示词见附录 B。

sents.en: We observe that conversations naturally express persistent facts about entities and their relationships, including who someone is, what they do, who they are connected to.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，对话会自然地表达关于实体及其关系的持久事实，包括某个人是谁、做什么、与谁相连。

sents.en: These relationships are better represented as structured relational tuples.
sents.zh: 这些关系更适合用结构化的关系元组来表示。

sents.en: To this end, we prompt an LLM to extract entity-relation tuples from the dialogues.
sents.zh: 为此，我们提示大语言模型从对话中抽取实体-关系元组。

sents.en: Each tuple is stored as ( e , r , o , t , c ) (e,\,r,\,o,\,t,\,c) .
sents.zh: 每个元组存储为 ( e , r , o , t , c ) (e,\,r,\,o,\,t,\,c) 。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 1 , e e is the entity , r r the relation label , o o the object , t t the timestamp , and c c the source context which captures the richer context from which the tuple was extracted.
sents.zh: 如图 1 所示， e e 是实体， r r 是关系标签， o o 是对象， t t 是时间戳， c c 是来源上下文，它捕获了元组被抽取时所处的更丰富的上下文。

sents.en: The contextual description c c provides provenance: it records not just what the tuple asserts but in what context it was mentioned, which is important for preserving nuance that structured extraction inevitably loses, such as the speaker’s intent, the circumstances under which a fact was stated, and additional details.
sents.zh: 上下文描述 c c 提供了来源追溯：它不仅记录元组断言了什么，还记录了它在什么上下文中被提及，这对于保留结构化抽取不可避免丢失的细微信息非常重要，例如说话者的意图、陈述某一事实时的情形，以及其他细节。

sents.en: The timestamp t t additionally grounds each triplet temporally, addressing a common failure mode of relation-based memory where relational facts are stored without any record of when they were true.
sents.zh: 时间戳 t t 还为每个三元组提供了时间上的锚定，解决了基于关系的记忆的一个常见失败模式，即关系事实在被存储时没有记录它们何时为真。

sents.en: The prompt for relational memory curation is shown in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 用于关系记忆整理的提示词见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: The most significant gains are observed in Multi-Hop and Temporal reasoning tasks, which directly reflect the strengths of our dual-memory setup. Episodic memory preserves interactions as a timestamped timeline, allowing the model to track the order of events for temporal questions. Meanwhile, structured relational memories capture complex entity-relation dependencies, facilitating effective multi-hop inference over distinct facts. Appendix D provides an ablation study on the contribution of each component. The results demonstrate that the most substantial improvements (+6.3 points in Multi-Hop and +6.8 points in Temporal reasoning on gpt-4o-mini ) emerge due to interaction between the two memory types.
paragraphs.zh: 最显著的提升出现在多跳（Multi-Hop）和时间（Temporal）推理任务上，这直接体现了我们双记忆机制的优势。 情景记忆将交互保存为带有时间戳的时间线，使模型能够追踪事件的先后顺序以回答时间类问题。 同时，结构化的关系记忆捕捉复杂的实体-关系依赖，促进对不同事实之间的高效多跳推理。 附录 D 提供了关于各组件贡献的消融研究。 结果表明，最显著的提升（在 gpt-4o-mini 上多跳推理提升 6.3 分、时间推理提升 6.8 分）源于两种记忆类型之间的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: We presented a Hybrid memory system for agents that curates and retrieves both episodic memory and structured relational memory, and conducted an empirical study across LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S. paragraphs.en: While our proposed memory system demonstrates strong performance, several areas remain for further refinement. First, our current evaluation focuses exclusively on textual conversational data. Although the system is modality agnostic, extending it to support non-textual modalities such as vision and audio remains an important direction for future work. Second, our experiments reveal that memory curation quality can vary substantially across different backbone LLMs, as observed shifting from gpt-4.1-mini to gpt-4o-mini resulted in a 6.7 percentage point drop. This sensitivity reflects a broader challenge faced by existing agentic memory systems, where memory curation and consolidation are inherently influenced by model-specific reasoning and representation biases. Developing memory mechanisms that are robust and consistent across diverse model families remains an open and important research problem.

paragraphs.en: Prior memory systems differ from ours along three axes: representation , curation strategy , and operational cost . We summarize the key contrasts below.
paragraphs.zh: 已有的记忆系统与我们提出的系统在三个维度上有所不同：表示方式、整理策略以及运行成本。 我们在下表中总结了主要的对比。

sents.en: Prior memory systems differ from ours along three axes: representation , curation strategy , and operational cost .
sents.zh: 已有的记忆系统与我们提出的系统在三个维度上有所不同：表示方式、整理策略以及运行成本。

sents.en: We summarize the key contrasts below.
sents.zh: 我们在下表中总结了主要的对比。

paragraphs.en: Zep Rasmussen et al. (2025) maintains a temporal knowledge graph with entity nodes, fact edges, and validity intervals, enabling graph traversal at the cost of entity resolution, edge deduplication, and conflict detection. A-Mem Xu et al. (2026) organizes memories as Zettelkasten-style notes with evolving links between entries, while H-Mem Sun and Zeng (2025) relies on hierarchical indexing for routing. In contrast, we use two complementary flat stores: episodic records that preserve narrative context and relational tuples retrieved by semantic similarity. This sacrifices native graph traversal but avoids the overhead of graph construction and hierarchy maintenance.
paragraphs.zh: Zep（Rasmussen 等，2025）维护一个包含实体节点、事实边和有效区间的时间知识图谱，支持图遍历，但代价是需要进行实体消解、边去重和冲突检测。A-Mem（Xu 等，2026）以 Zettelkasten 风格的笔记形式组织记忆，并在条目之间建立不断演化的链接；而 H-Mem（Sun 和 Zeng，2025）则依赖分层索引进行路由。相比之下，我们采用两个互补的扁平存储：保留叙事上下文的情景记录，以及通过语义相似度检索的关系元组。这牺牲了原生的图遍历能力，但避免了图构建和层级维护的开销。

paragraphs.en: Mem0 Chhikara et al. (2025) processes each turn individually with add/update/delete/no-op operations, which fragments inter-turn context. Nemori Nan et al. (2025) adaptively distills semantic knowledge based on prediction error against an anticipatory schema, focusing on what to store. Our method instead targets how memory should be represented: we perform a single session-level curation pass that produces episodic and relational entries, and we apply offline clustering-based consolidation to merge redundant memories and remove outdated ones.

paragraphs.en: Turnwise systems such as Mem0 and A-Mem scale LLM calls linearly with conversation length, and dynamic retrieval schemes incur additional LLM rounds at query time. Our session-level curation amortizes extraction across many turns, and a fixed top- k k retrieval avoids extra LLM calls. Consolidation runs offline and can be triggered infrequently (e.g., every 10-20 sessions), keeping long-horizon operation tractable while preserving QA accuracy.
